title: [Advisory] Various WordPress Plugins: Critical RCE, SSRF and XSS
content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full site control via arbitrary file uploads, while authenticated attackers can query internal systems or execute malicious scripts.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Forminator Forms (WPMU DEV)
- User Profile Builder
- Royal Elementor Addons (WP Royal)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** For Forminator, the target site must have a form containing both a File Upload and a Select field. Royal Elementor flaws require Contributor-level access or higher.
- **Impact Details:** Forminator's flaw bypasses file extension blocklists via manipulated MIME types. Royal Elementor's flaws allow internal service querying and stored cross-site scripting via unvalidated widget settings.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches are available for both affected plugins.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-15748 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Arbitrary file upload leading to unauthenticated remote code execution
- CVE-2026-15826 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Authentication bypass allowing administrative takeover
- CVE-2026-17123 CVSS3.1: 8.8 (HIGH) - Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) allowing access to internal systems.
- CVE-2026-19217 CVSS3.1: 6.4 (MEDIUM) - Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) allowing arbitrary web script injection

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:

- Vendor Advisory for CVE-2026-15826: https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/profile-builder/user-profile-builder-3164-unauthenticated-authentication-bypass-via-type-confusion-to-administrator-account-takeover-via-username-parameter

- Vendor Advisory for CVE-2026-19217: https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/royal-elementor-addons/royal-elementor-addons-171064-authenticated-contributor-stored-cross-site-scripting

summary: Critical security vulnerabilities have been discovered in two widely used WordPress plugins, Forminator Forms, User Profile Builder and Royal Elementor Addons. These flaws could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, and authenticated attackers to forge server-side requests or inject malicious scripts into affected websites.
